overview.description: The Meta AI Lab Ecosystem ETF (MTAW) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund actively manages a portfolio of equity securities positioned to benefit from Meta Platforms, Inc. (META) and companies with the strongest connections to its AI ecosystem, across US and non-US markets, including emerging markets MTAW was launched on Aug 12, 2026 and is issued by Harbor.
